critical_code_review_comments: Verified NO `users.status` references remain in any route/middleware (grep confirmed only `account_status` is referenced) — column rename is clean.
Verified employer creation via /api/admin/employers auto-approves (approval_status='approved', account_status='active') and inserts a notification, allowing immediate login.
Verified `VALID_STATUSES` enum in employer.js accepts the 6 capstone statuses and explicitly rejects 'hired' with 400.
Verified /api/admin/jobs/:id/close is a soft removal (status='closed', UPDATE only — never DELETE) and the record remains visible in /api/admin/jobs.
Verified /api/nsrp/extract returns 200 with success=false + helpful 'manual' notice + 15-key editable scaffold when OCR can't read the image (tested with a 1×1 PNG).
Verified /api/jobs (public listing) filters to status='active' only — closed jobs do NOT leak.
Verified deactivated seeker (account_status='suspended') returns 403 on login.
